sources.title: MidhunKanadan/ModernBERT-CritiQ-V2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: 🔍 ModernBERT-CritiQ: Critical Question Usefulness Classifier This model classifies critical questions as either Useful or Non-Useful in the context of an argument (intervention). It is fine-tuned on Critical Question Generation datasets using a ModernBERT architecture with extended context.

sources.title: critiq — AI Code Reviewer for VS Code - GitHub
sources.snippet: critiq — AI Code Reviewer for VS Code AI-powered code review directly in VS Code. Reviews your git changes before you push, shows issues as inline diagnostics and in a dedicated sidebar panel, and auto-fixes issues with a single click. Supports Claude, OpenAI, or local Ollama.
